correctness.rationale: The integer lattice correspondence is exact, and the disjoint \(\mathrm{range}\le m\) versus \(\mathrm{range}>m\) partition is exhaustive because each missing edge belongs to a matching. Uniqueness of extreme labels and their common admissible interval yields the exact all-m formula. The Eulerian generating-series identity is algebraic, and a nonnegative gamma recurrence gives the gamma coefficients. The continuous real decomposition uses the same uniqueness and its rooted-chart Jacobian is exactly \(1/\sqrt n\). Independent brute integer checks (34 dilation profiles), six \(h^*\) profiles and eight numerical hull checks agreed. No extrapolation from finite tests is needed.

value.rationale: The matching-deleted complete graphs form a natural infinite geometric family. The proof determines every integer-dilation lattice count and an explicit gamma-nonnegative Ehrhart numerator, beyond an isolated low-dimensional computation. Independent pairwise metric relaxations generate a nontrivial exact volume superposition law without cross-interactions; the relative volume-change formula quantifies the geometric robustness of a complete-graph polar under extensive disjoint edge deletions. These are motivated natural invariants of polar symmetric edge polytopes, not arbitrary statistics.
